defs.def: a piece of body tissue that you contract and relax in order to move a particular part of the body; the tissue that forms the muscles of the body 肌肉；肌

ex.s: Since setting out on the journey, the ___47___ lover has not only managed to ___48___ an impressive set of muscles but also a huge following on social media.
ex.t: 自踏上这段旅程以来，这位___47____爱好者不仅练出了一身令人惊叹的肌肉，还在社交媒体上收获了大批粉丝。

ex.s: You’ll develop that painting muscle memory that only comes with repetition.
ex.t: 你会形成那种只有通过重复才能获得的绘画肌肉记忆。

ex.s: This develops your core muscles and strengthens your lower back.
ex.t: 这能锻炼你的核心肌肉，强化你的下背部。

ex.s: He seized Tom by the jaw, and pulled open his mouth to inspect his teeth; made him strip up his sleeve, to show his muscle; turned him round, made him jump and spring, to show his paces.
ex.t: 他抓住汤姆的下巴，扒开他的嘴检查牙齿；让他卷起袖子展示肌肉；让他转圈、跳跃，展示他的步态。

ex.s: With no gravity to push against, astronauts’ bones and muscles can become weak.
ex.t: 没有重力可以对抗，宇航员的骨骼和肌肉会变得虚弱。

ex.s: All that fat has become muscle now.
ex.t: 所有的脂肪现在都变成了肌肉。

ex.s: Some members like to 1_______yoga because it helps them keep their muscles toned, while others love to 2________aerobics - one elderly man says the energy of it makes him feel young again!
ex.t: 有些成员喜欢 1_______ 瑜伽，因为这有助于保持肌肉张力，而其他人喜欢 2________ 健美操——一位年长的男士说它的能量让他又感到年轻起来！

defs.def: the power and influence to make others do what you want 权力；威信；影响力
